steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Resistance checks must be made with washer unplugged or power disconnected.

steps.title: Access main control
steps.body: Remove console. Verify ALL connectors fully seated at ACU.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove console. Verify ALL connectors fully seated at ACU.

steps.title: Restore power for line check
steps.body: Plug in or reconnect power for live measurements only.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Plug in or reconnect power for live measurements only.

steps.title: Line voltage J1-1 to J1-2
steps.body: AC voltmeter: black probe J1-1 (Neutral), red probe J1-2 (Line). Expect 120 VAC.

branches.label: No line voltage
branches.oemOutcome: Check outlet, breaker, and AC power cord continuity.

steps.sourceExcerpt: AC voltmeter: black probe J1-1 (Neutral), red probe J1-2 (Line). Expect 120 VAC.

steps.title: Diagnostic LED state
steps.body: Is the Diagnostic LED flashing, continuously ON, or OFF?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Flashing: proceed to HMI Test. ON/OFF: continue ACU DC checks.

steps.title: Isolate HMI load on J14
steps.body: Disconnect power. Remove connector J14 from main control. Restore power and recheck Diagnostic LED.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power. Remove connector J14 from main control. Restore power and recheck Diagnostic LED.

steps.title: LED flashes with J14 removed?
steps.body: With J14 disconnected, does Diagnostic LED flash?

branches.label: Yes — flashes without HMI
branches.oemOutcome: HMI or HMI harness fault — see TEST #4 HMI.

steps.sourceExcerpt: With J14 disconnected, does Diagnostic LED flash?

steps.title: +12.7 VDC at J14
steps.body: DC volts: black J14-4 (Circuit Gnd), red J14-1 (+12.7 VDC). Do not short pins.
steps.sourceExcerpt: DC volts: black J14-4 (Circuit Gnd), red J14-1 (+12.7 VDC). Do not short pins.

branches.label: No line voltage
branches.oemOutcome: Check outlet, breaker, and AC power cord continuity.

branches.label: Yes — flashes without HMI
branches.oemOutcome: HMI or HMI harness fault — see TEST #4 HMI.

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool & Maytag 4.7/5.3 cu ft Top Load Washer (Direct Drive)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Resistance checks must be made with washer unplugged or power disconnected.

steps.title: Component Activation valve pre-check
steps.body: In Component Activation, run Cold, Hot, Oxi (if equipped), and Fabric Softener valve tests. Note any valve that fails to energize.
steps.sourceExcerpt: In Component Activation, run Cold, Hot, Oxi (if equipped), and Fabric Softener valve tests. Note any valve that fails to energize.

steps.title: Disconnect J16 at ACU
steps.body: Unplug washer. Remove console. Disconnect J16 from main control.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug washer. Remove console. Disconnect J16 from main control.

steps.title: Valve coil resistance at J16
steps.body: Measure each suspect coil across J16-1 (common) and valve pin: Cold J16-1&2, Hot J16-1&5, Fabric Softener J16-1&6, Oxi J16-1&7. Expect 890–1090 Ω.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Measure each suspect coil across J16-1 (common) and valve pin: Cold J16-1&2, Hot J16-1&5, Fabric Softener J16-1&6, Oxi J16-1&7. Expect 890–1090 Ω.

steps.title: Reconnect J16 and restore power
steps.body: Reconnect J16. Reassemble panels. Restore power for Component Activation valve exercise.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reconnect J16. Reassemble panels. Restore power for Component Activation valve exercise.

steps.title: Continue to Component Activation
steps.body: You should now be in Service Mode. Use Left/Right to navigate, Select/Enter to open Service Diagnostics, then Component Activation for live load tests.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Service Mode must be active before Component Activation (Service Diagnostics menu).

steps.title: Valves energize in Component Activation
steps.body: Toggle affected valve functions in Component Activation. Does each valve in question turn on?

branches.label: Ohms OK but valve does not run
branches.oemOutcome: Coils in range but no run — replace main control.

steps.sourceExcerpt: Toggle affected valve functions in Component Activation. Does each valve in question turn on?

branches.label: Ohms OK but valve does not run
branches.oemOutcome: Coils in range but no run — replace main control.

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Resistance checks must be made with washer unplugged or power disconnected.

steps.title: Enter Service Mode and clear codes
steps.body: Activate Service Mode. Retrieve and clear F7E3, F7E4, F7E6, F7E7, F7E8, F7E9, F7EA if present.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Activate Service Mode. Retrieve and clear F7E3, F7E4, F7E6, F7E7, F7E8, F7E9, F7EA if present.

steps.title: Slow Agitate in Component Activation
steps.body: In Component Activation, run Slow Agitate. Does motor run after 15–20 seconds?
steps.sourceExcerpt: In Component Activation, run Slow Agitate. Does motor run after 15–20 seconds?

steps.title: Spin Low Speed test
steps.body: Run Spin Low Speed in Component Activation. If motor hums briefly then stops, check fault code display.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Run Spin Low Speed in Component Activation. If motor hums briefly then stops, check fault code display.

steps.title: Continue to shifter or motor test
steps.body: Shifter-related (F7E3/F7E4) → TEST #3a Shifter. Motor circuit (F7E6–F7EA) → TEST #3b Motor.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Shifter-related (F7E3/F7E4) → TEST #3a Shifter. Motor circuit (F7E6–F7EA) → TEST #3b Motor.

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool & Maytag 4.7/5.3 cu ft Top Load Washer (Direct Drive)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Resistance checks must be made with washer unplugged or power disconnected.

steps.title: Spin and Agitate in Component Activation
steps.body: Lid closed and locked. Run Spin and Agitate under Component Activation. Did shifter engage for both?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Lid closed and locked. Run Spin and Agitate under Component Activation. Did shifter engage for both?

steps.title: Motor and shifter turn independently
steps.body: Power off. Motor and shifter should turn independently. If locked together, shifter slider issue.

branches.label: Locked together or bound
branches.oemOutcome: Replace drive — slider binds or motor/shifter locked.

steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Motor and shifter should turn independently. If locked together, shifter slider issue.

steps.title: J3 fully seated
steps.body: Verify J3 inserted fully at ACU.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify J3 inserted fully at ACU.

steps.title: Reseat J3 and retest
steps.body: Reconnect J3 and repeat Component Activation Spin/Agitate.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reconnect J3 and repeat Component Activation Spin/Agitate.

steps.title: Live shifter voltage check
steps.body: Restore power. AC volts J15-1 (Neutral) to J15-4 (Shifter). Command shifter ON/OFF in Component Activation (motor stopped). Expect 120 VAC.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Restore power. AC volts J15-1 (Neutral) to J15-4 (Shifter). Command shifter ON/OFF in Component Activation (motor stopped). Expect 120 VAC.

steps.title: 120 VAC at shifter when commanded
steps.body: Is 120 VAC present at J15-1 to J15-4 when shifter commanded?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Is 120 VAC present at J15-1 to J15-4 when shifter commanded?

steps.title: Shifter harness continuity
steps.body: Power off. Tilt washer. Continuity J15-1 (White) to shifter pin 3 and J15-4 (Orange) to shifter pin 1?

branches.label: Open harness
branches.oemOutcome: Replace lower washer harness.

steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Tilt washer. Continuity J15-1 (White) to shifter pin 3 and J15-4 (Orange) to shifter pin 1?

steps.title: Shifter slider moves freely
steps.body: Remove motor bolt, cover, stator, and shifter coil. Slider on shaft moves freely without rubbing?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove motor bolt, cover, stator, and shifter coil. Slider on shaft moves freely without rubbing?

branches.label: Locked together or bound
branches.oemOutcome: Replace drive — slider binds or motor/shifter locked.

branches.label: Open harness
branches.oemOutcome: Replace lower washer harness.

steps.body: Verify J3 fully inserted.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify J3 fully inserted.

steps.title: Reseat J3 and retest
steps.body: Reconnect J3 and repeat Component Activation spin.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reconnect J3 and repeat Component Activation spin.

steps.title: Motor resistance at J3
steps.body: Ohms J3 1-2 and 1-3. Each expect 8–10 Ω. Much higher than 10 or less than 8 → motor/drive path.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Ohms J3 1-2 and 1-3. Each expect 8–10 Ω. Much higher than 10 or less than 8 → motor/drive path.

steps.title: Motor harness continuity J3 to drive
steps.body: Tilt washer. Continuity all J3 pins to drive motor connector?

branches.oemOutcome: Replace lower washer harness.

steps.sourceExcerpt: Tilt washer. Continuity all J3 pins to drive motor connector?

steps.title: Motor resistance at drive connector
steps.body: Disconnect motor connector at drive. Measure 2-4 (R-BR) and 2-3 (BR-BK). Expect 8–10 Ω each.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect motor connector at drive. Measure 2-4 (R-BR) and 2-3 (BR-BK). Expect 8–10 Ω each.

steps.title: Motor connection cover seated
steps.body: Remove shifter coil and stator. Motor electrical connection cover fully seated?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove shifter coil and stator. Motor electrical connection cover fully seated?

steps.title: Seat motor connection cover
steps.body: Fully seat cover, reassemble, and repeat Component Activation spin.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Fully seat cover, reassemble, and repeat Component Activation spin.

steps.title: Reconnect motor and restore power
steps.body: Reconnect motor harness. Reassemble. Restore power for Component Activation spin.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reconnect motor harness. Reassemble. Restore power for Component Activation spin.

steps.title: Continue to Component Activation
steps.body: You should now be in Service Mode. Use Left/Right to navigate, Select/Enter to open Service Diagnostics, then Component Activation for live load tests.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Service Mode must be active before Component Activation (Service Diagnostics menu).

steps.title: Motor runs in Component Activation
steps.body: Command Low/Mid/High spin in Component Activation. Does motor run at commanded speed?

branches.label: Does not run
branches.oemOutcome: Motor ohms OK but no run — replace ACU.

steps.sourceExcerpt: Command Low/Mid/High spin in Component Activation. Does motor run at commanded speed?

branches.label: Does not turn freely
branches.oemOutcome: Resolve mechanical friction or lockup before motor replacement.

branches.oemOutcome: Replace lower washer harness.

branches.label: Does not run
